energy_transport_communications_logistic.name: Energy, transport, communications, and logistics
blocking_questions: Independent infrastructure review has not passed.
Access points do not provide full facility polygons, engineering systems, storage, fuel, repair, defenses, or physical capacity.
Observed activity is utilization and must not be interpreted as maximum throughput, mobilization capacity, readiness, or guaranteed service.
The airport 2025 activity workbook and port geometry snapshot have explicit retrospective evidence limits that must remain visible to consumers.
Military ownership, military tenancy, military access, defenses, target status, and damage susceptibility have not been assessed.
Road, rail, inland waterway, power, fuel, communications, route, fleet, repair, substitution, and hinterland network links are not populated.
energy_transport_communications_logistic.notes: This rollup is a research index over two independently validated collecting packets. It does not merge port and airport semantics, create military facilities, or authorize executable simulation behavior. The exact source derived points are civilian access nodes and observed activity is not engineering capacity.

geography_provinces_terrain.name: Geography, provinces, terrain, rivers, and maritime access
blocking_questions: Independent geographic review has not passed.
Township, district, village, terrain, river, port, airfield, and transport corridor overlays are not part of this artifact.
Administrative assignment of outlying islands is preserved as published and must not be interpreted as a neutral sovereignty determination.
geography_provinces_terrain.notes: This is source derived administrative geometry for the opening bookmark. It is suitable for research and map aggregation after validation, but the lane remains collecting until an independent reviewer accepts geographic completeness and contested territory semantics. The published polygons are exact source derived geometry at the declared operational precision.
